### In progress

- **[Rigid Origami: Kinematics, Rigidity and Design](rigid-origami/index.html)** — the mathematics of folding with rigid faces: single vertices, configuration spaces, degree-of-freedom counting, quad meshes, and what is still unknown. *Started November 2026.*

### Planned

- **Folding from Crease Patterns** — a practical, interactive guide: reading a CP, finding the structure, precreasing and collapsing, with animated foldings.

Each book has a PDF download on its own page and a version history on GitHub.
